user.title: Ingress
user.description:
Local UI: manage panels here without an agent or YAML. After setup, choose Configure to add panels.
Agent: connect to an already running external ingress agent.
YAML: manage panels in configuration.yaml.

my_agent.title: Ingress agent
my_agent.description: Enter the URL of your already running ingress agent.

import_yaml.title: Import YAML panels
import_yaml.description: Copy the current YAML panels into the local UI. Resolved !secret values, including headers and tokens, will be stored in the Home Assistant configuration entry. Further YAML edits will not update these panels. Confirm to import and switch modes; cancel to keep YAML unchanged.

data.confirm: Import panels and switch to local UI

add.title: Add panel
add.description: Enter the panel address and sidebar details. Open Advanced to configure child panels, authentication, dynamic URLs, headers, and ordered response rewrites. Empty optional fields remove the saved setting. Header values and static tokens are stored in the Home Assistant configuration entry; static tokens remain valid until changed.

data_description.static_token: Creates a public access link that bypasses Home Assistant login. Leave empty to require login.
data_description.headers: Values are stored in the Home Assistant configuration entry.

data_description.url: Dynamic URLs use this address as their default. Proxy modes accept a host and port. Iframe and custom modes also accept a /relative URL.
data_description.title: Leave empty to hide the panel from the sidebar.
data_description.require_admin: Controls sidebar visibility; it does not add backend authorization.
